note: Jefferson County NE zoning districts are published only through the Beacon (Schneider) viewer, which is not a public ArcGIS REST service and returned 403/Cloudflare to automated reads, and as a static PDF zoning map. The county GIS is stated to be not publicly accessible; the county's gworks ArcGIS server (mapserver01.gworks.com/Jefferson_County_NE_Clerk, _EM) has no zoning layer. Fairbury (largest city) publishes only its 2013 ordinance PDF and a district list, with no queryable zoning layer.
